title: Prometheus chained in the Caucasus by Zeus

tellings.quote: Prometheus is punished by Zeus, right? And chained in the Caucasus and has his liver devoured.

plain: In the Greek myth, Prometheus is punished by Zeus by being chained in the Caucasus mountains, where his liver is devoured. A researcher named Jason Jorjani retells it on the show, without naming a source, in a conversation about secret wartime technology, using the old story as a picture of what happens to those who hand forbidden knowledge to humans.
